description:
Aakhri Steam Trains: Kya Band Ho Jayengi? 💨

🚂 Living steam heritage preservation

While commercial mainline steam ended in the 1990s on major world networks, countries like India, UK, and Germany maintain working steam locomotives in specialized heritage sheds like the Rewari Steam Centre for tourist and special runs.

👉 Kya heritage steam trains ko hamesha zinda rakhna chahiye?
